resources.basis: Scenario stock, not verified availability: two hand-tool kits, 20 ties, one cart, one pre-fitted barrier, 100 bags/fill and eight pumps. Crew count and positions come from the saved world.
resources.travel_basis: Grid walking route at 1.4 m/s, including return to starting location; dry pre-storm access is assumed.

reasons: Achieves the lowest expected flood damage at $1,083,773,901.21, which is $127,046.03 lower than work_control and $47,094.92 lower than work_candidate3.

Completes both clear-inlet:158769 and clear-inlet:305510 within the 30-minute limit (29.57 and 27.57 crew minutes), reducing local water depths from 28 cm to 26 cm and from 21 cm to 20 cm compared to no preparation.
Causes zero route closures and leaves wet boxes at 60, matching all other tested plans.
Trades off 77 L to 154 L of indoor rain entry reduction offered by work_candidate3 (63,217 L) and work_candidate2 (63,140 L) in exchange for the largest reduction in flood damage dollars.
